evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: The system retrieves similar historical 2D images and poses, matches them to the current view, and refines robot pose before local graph updates.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Object nodes and spatial relations form a dynamic 3D scene graph whose updated structure is traversed for planning and remains linked to geometric and historical visual evidence.

After interaction, fixed geometric checks locally update object features and the affected scene graph rather than reconstructing the full scene. For DovSG, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of 3D object nodes with geometric and semantic features.

Obsolete indices are removed and low- and high-level graph relations are rebuilt for changed regions. For DovSG, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of 3D object nodes with geometric and semantic features.

New RGB-D evidence is checked against fixed depth and color criteria; obsolete points are removed and affected graph state is recomputed. For DovSG, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of 3D object nodes with geometric and semantic features.

derived.hybrid_relation: Both operative paths remain within the source-preserving/modality-native parent family.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (3D object nodes with geometric and semantic features) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
